hero.headline: What's New in SiteFlow
hero.subhead: Explore the latest features and module updates engineered for real-world construction management, from task planning actuals to bank transfers.

features.title: Task Planning: Actuals, Forecasts and Replan
features.body: SiteFlow now tracks planned and actual dates separately. When a task starts, the actual start date is captured; when it completes, the actual end date is recorded.
bullets: Forecasted end date from current pace
Automatic delay detection: On Track, At Risk, Delayed, Early

features.title: Bank Account Management: Transfers
features.body: Manage your bank accounts directly in SiteFlow. Record fund movements between accounts, track cash deposits, and get a clean account statement.
bullets: Bank to bank transfers in a few taps

faqs.q: How often does SiteFlow release features?
faqs.a: We push continuous updates weekly, with major version releases quarterly.

faqs.q: Do I need to update the app?
faqs.a: Web updates are automatic. Mobile apps prompt for an update when critical features are added.
